detail.longDescription: The Quiet Grief of Becoming Nobody tells you that becoming a better version of yourself can come with grief. We talk about growth as though it is always exciting. We celebrate the woman who has found her voice, learned to set boundaries, and decided that she deserves better. But sometimes, when she finally begins to understand herself, she also begins to mourn. She mourns the years she spent doubting her worth. She mourns the opportunities she was too afraid to pursue.
